library_preparation_preflight.summary: Add Micrometer test fixtures so observations and parent/child spans are observable without a live Couchbase server.

deterministic_setup.reason: Provides TestObservationRegistry used by the upstream 3.11.3 tests. [module POM](https://github.com/couchbase/couchbase-jvm-clients/blob/3.11.3/tracing-micrometer-observation/pom.xml)

Provides SimpleTracer and tracing assertions for verifying wrapped observations and parent propagation, matching Micrometer’s unit-test guidance. [Micrometer testing documentation](https://docs.micrometer.io/tracing/reference/testing.html)

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Create an ObservationRegistry with a tracing handler backed by SimpleTracer. Exercise ObservationRequestTracer.wrap, null and explicit parent spans, operation names, client kind, attributes, exception recording, and end/stop behavior. No system property or live Couchbase service is required for artifact-level coverage; the Couchbase SDK’s requestTracer environment wiring is optional. [Upstream unit test](https://github.com/couchbase/couchbase-jvm-clients/blob/3.11.3/tracing-micrometer-observation/src/integrationTest/java/com/couchbase/client/tracing/observation/ObservationRequestTracerTests.java)
risks: A full end-to-end Couchbase request test would additionally require java-client/test infrastructure and a running Couchbase cluster; local Gradle and Native Image verification remain authoritative.
The tracing test fixture may influence Micrometer version resolution, so verify the resolved graph locally.
